summary: CRT _filbuf-style stream buffer refill on read underflow. Operates on a FILE descriptor array (a1[0]=read pointer, a1[1]=byte count, a1[2]=buffer base, a1[3]=flags, a1[4]=OS file handle, a1[6]=buffer size). Rejects invalid or write-mode streams, allocates a buffer via MemoryAllocatorInit when needed, reads up to a1[6] bytes from the handle via sub_58C9B4, sets EOF (16) or error (32) flags on failure, copies text-mode descriptor state from unk_5E7898 or the dword_8D4920 descriptor table, auto-grows a default 512-byte buffer to 4096, and returns the first buffered byte while advancing the read pointer.

local_names.a1: FILE-style descriptor array (a1[0]=read ptr, a1[1]=count, a1[2]=base, a1[3]=flags, a1[4]=handle, a1[6]=bufsiz)
local_names.v2: number of bytes returned by the sub_58C9B4 read
local_names.v4: text-mode descriptor selected for this handle

operations.description: Read stream flags from a1[3] (this+0xC); when (flags & 0x83) == 0 or (flags & 0x40) != 0 the stream is unusable for refill, so return -1.
When (flags & 2) is set, OR 0x20 into the flags (EOF-style state), store them back, and return -1.
Set the low 'buffer active' bit by storing flags | 1 back into a1[3] (this+0xC).

When the 16-bit flags test (flags & 0x10C) is nonzero the buffer is already established, so set the read pointer *a1 (this+0x0) to the buffer base a1[2] (this+0x8); otherwise initialize the buffer via MemoryAllocatorInit(a1).
Read bytes from the OS handle a1[4] (this+0x10) into the buffer base a1[2] (this+0x8) requesting a1[6] (this+0x18) bytes via sub_58C9B4, and store the returned count into a1[1] (this+0x4).
When the read returns 0 or 0xFFFFFFFF (-1), OR 32 (error) or 16 (EOF) into the flags this+0xC, clear the count this+0x4 to 0, and return -1.

When (flags & 0x82) == 0, resolve the text-mode descriptor: for handle this+0x10 == 0xFFFFFFFF use the default descriptor unk_5E7898, otherwise index dword_8D4920[handle >> 5] + 36 * (handle & 0x1F); when descriptor[4] & 0x82 == 0x82, OR 0x20 into the high flags byte and store back to this+0xC.
When the buffer size this+0x18 equals the default 512 and (flags & 8) is set while the flags byte-1 & 4 bit is clear, grow the buffer size to 4096.
Store the remaining byte count this+0x4 as v2 - 1, return the buffered byte value at the current read pointer (obj), and advance the read pointer this+0x0 by 1.
Function 0x0058C255 is the per-character underflow refill handler invoked by FileReadUntilNewline, sub_58806E, StreamGetcWithUnderflowHandler, BufferedByteReader, and sub_59BE0C.

unresolved: The exact text-mode descriptor fields beyond descriptor[4] (flag byte at +4) and their meaning are not recoverable from this function alone.
The high flags byte 0x20 set from the descriptor (and its byte-1 & 4 companion bit) is written here but consumed by other stream functions.
The auto-grow to 4096 applies only when the buffer size is exactly the 512 default; other buffer sizes are left untouched.
